name: Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information in Nonfederal Systems and Organizations
issuing_organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology
notes: Defines security requirements for protecting CUI in nonfederal systems. Rev 3 is available but Rev 2 remains widely referenced.

derives_from.note: Requirements derived from moderate-baseline 800-53 controls tailored for nonfederal systems.
CUI regulation requires nonfederal systems handling CUI to meet 800-171 requirements.
